name: artifact-runtime-script-target-preserved-no-finding
description: A carried client script whose interactive DOM target survives conversion (the toggle's aria-controls target is preserved verbatim) emits no runtime_script_target_missing finding.

source_reference.notes: Negative coverage for script-target parity: when the interactive target referenced by a carried first-party client script remains present in the generated block markup, runtime dependency parity stays clean (no false positive).

legacy_comparison.reason: Runtime dependency parity is an upstream artifact compiler contract with no legacy comparison.

files.content: document.querySelectorAll('[aria-controls]').forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener('click', function () { var t = document.getElementById(b.getAttribute('aria-controls')); if (t) { t.hidden = !t.hidden; } }); });
